id.description: ACTV-3. The Worker's own id for this activity. Opaque to everyone else.

since.description: ACTV-3. When the activity entered its current state, as an RFC 3339 instant carrying an offset. For `running`, when work began; for `pending`, when it joined the queue, which is what makes a stuck one visible; for `scheduled`, when the Worker undertook it — and never when it will next run, which is scheduling and a non-goal.

summary.description: ACTV-3. Human-readable, and parsed by nothing. The reader this surface exists for is a person asking what a Worker is doing; what a program acts on is the state.

title: Activity
description: ACTV-3. One thing a Worker is doing or has undertaken to do, while it holds it.
